topic: Ask HN: Does anyone else feel like nothing matters anymore?
headline: Feeling Overwhelmed as a Dev?
caption:
Today I saw a post on Hacker News asking if anyone else feels like nothing matters anymore. As a fellow engineer, I get it. The fast pace of tech can sometimes make us wonder if our work truly makes a difference. But I believe that every line of code we write adds up, shaping solutions that impact real lives. Remember to take breaks, reflect on your purpose, and celebrate small wins. We’re all in this together. Keep pushing forward! 💻✨

#FullStackDeveloper #TechLife #EngineerThoughts
